Touch.description: Touch filter, gestures and pointer thresholds shared by every surface.

LongPress.description: Time a finger must rest on a tile before its context menu opens instead of executing.

SwipeMinDistancePx.description: Horizontal travel that turns a gesture into a page swipe.

PostSwipeLock.description: Tiles ignore touches for this long after a page swipe.

DragMinDistancePx.description: Lower bound of the drag threshold; the effective threshold is max(this, cancelMovePx).

IgnoredTouchFeedback.description: Length of the discreet outline or vibration that signals an ignored touch.

PalmContactMinPx.description: A contact whose area (rcContact) reaches this width or height, in logical pixels (about 32 mm), is a palm and never counts. Provisional until spike S2 records real traces on the maintainer's touch screen.

PointerStampMaxAge.description: A pointer frame is dated when Windows recorded it (its performance counter); if that is older than this when the window procedure reads it (a stalled UI thread or a bogus counter), it is dated now instead.

ExecuteConfirmWindow.description: A shortcut that asks for confirmation stays armed this long after the first tap.

DestructiveConfirmWindow.description: Window for the second tap of every destructive operation (TwoStepConfirm).

Notices.description: Notice bar and status bar messages.

NoticeDuration.description: Time a normal notice stays visible.

UndoNoticeDuration.description: Time a notice that offers Undo stays visible.

ExecutionFlash.description: Colour flash of a tile after its action runs.

TestMode.description: Test mode: touches are filtered and marked but nothing is sent.

TestModeDuration.description: Test mode switches itself off after this long.

TestMarkDuration.description: Time a tile shows its accepted or ignored mark in test mode.

CollapseDelay.description: The open bar collapses this long after an action when it is set to collapse.

Dimming.description: Auto-dim of the panel, bar and bubble (DimPolicy).

DimDelay.description: Surfaces dim this long after the finger or the pointer leaves them.

DimTransition.description: Opacity transition of dimming; zero when reduce motion is on.

BubbleMinOpacity.description: The bubble and the bar handle never go below this opacity.

AutoReleaseChoices.description: Automatic release limits offered for held items; «Never» is a separate setting value.

ShiftBurstLimit.description: At most this many Shift presses per window; the next one is delayed so Windows Sticky Keys never triggers.

SuspendReleaseWait.description: The synchronous suspend handler waits up to this long for the engine to confirm the release.

MacroWaitRange.description: Allowed range and editing step of a macro wait step.

MacroWaitDefault.description: Duration of a newly added wait step.

ScrollRepeatSlow.description: Wheel repeat interval while a slow scroll is held.

ScrollRepeatNormal.description: Wheel repeat interval while a normal scroll is held.

ScrollRepeatFast.description: Wheel repeat interval while a fast scroll is held.

InterEventDelay.description: Pause between injected events; zero sends one atomic SendInput batch. docs/03 suggests about 15 ms, v1 needed 20 ms (DIS-95); the blueprint starts at 20 ms until S7 measures it.

ClipboardRestoreDelay.description: The original clipboard is restored this long after a paste-method text action.

ClipboardCaptureMaxBytes.description: Largest clipboard content captured for restoration.

Engine.description: Engine actor, heartbeat and generation fence.

LedgerHeartbeatInterval.description: The engine writes its heartbeat to the key ledger at least this often.

EngineStallThreshold.description: Without heartbeat progress for this long, SysEvents runs the emergency release.

EmergencyGateWait.description: Longest wait of the emergency releaser for the injection gate before escalating to a process restart.

EngineHangLoop.description: This many engine hangs within the window escalate directly to a process restart.

UiPingInterval.description: The engine pings the UI dispatcher this often.

UiHangThreshold.description: A dispatcher that does not answer for this long is logged as hung.

UiHangRestartOffer.description: After this long hung, the tray offers to restart Clícalo.

SnapshotCoalescing.description: At most one engine snapshot reaches the UI per this interval (about one frame).

PipeHeartbeatInterval.description: Heartbeat period on the pipe inherited by the guardian.

RestartBackoff.description: Waits before relaunching a guardian that died.

RestartLoop.description: Guardian deaths within the window that stop relaunching and raise a warning in System › Startup and stability.

CrashLoop.description: Main process crashes within the window after which the next start enters safe mode.

UpdateHealthTimeout.description: After an update the new version must show the panel, load the document and run the engine within this time.

UnconfirmedStartsBeforeSafeMode.description: Consecutive starts without health confirmation that trigger safe mode and the rollback offer.

HandoverFlushTimeout.description: Longest document flush before relaunching elevated.

HandoverMutexWait.description: The elevated instance waits this long for the previous instance to release the single-instance mutex.

ExitReleaseWait.description: On exit the engine has this long to release everything and stop; the process ends anyway afterwards and Sentinel releases whatever the ledger still records.

ExitFlushTimeout.description: Longest flush of the document and usage when Clícalo exits.

SentinelLateThreshold.description: A guardian that is not running this long after the first frame is logged as startup.sentinel_late (the accepted gap of blueprint §3.1 and §15.2).

TextInputLeaseIdle.description: A text input lease without interaction ends after this long and the foreground is restored.

SurfaceIntegrityInterval.description: Period of the check that re-applies WS_EX_NOACTIVATE and topmost to every surface.

RestoreRetryDelay.description: After a SetForegroundWindow that GetForegroundWindow does not confirm yet, wait this long and check again (the thread that owns the window activates it asynchronously); the single retry of a lease that takes or gives back the foreground follows the same wait. Provisional: S4 measured the first check failing and this one succeeding in 20 of 20 cycles.

RightsHotkeyTimeout.description: Longest wait for WM_HOTKEY after injecting the internal rights chord (step 2 of the ladder for UI Automation origins). Provisional until spike S4 measures it.

ChordReleasePoll.description: After WM_HOTKEY of the internal rights chord, the keys of the chord are sampled this often (GetAsyncKeyState) until they are all up, at most RightsHotkeyTimeout, before the foreground is taken: each key message goes to the thread in front when the system processes it, so the releases must reach the app that received the presses (spike S4: a left Ctrl release that arrived after the retry went to the new foreground).

TouchKeyboardPoll.description: While Clícalo has shown the touch keyboard, its covered area is sampled this often so the panel can move above it. Provisional until spike S4 measures it.

ViolationRestoreBudget.description: After an activation without a lease, the previous external foreground must be back within this time (ActivationGuardNegativeTests, spike S1).

ActivationRecheck.description: An activation message that reaches a surface while the foreground is outside the process is judged again once the UI thread has delivered what it had queued and, if the foreground is still outside, once more after this wait: a window of the process in front without a lease is one violation, anything else was a late message. It is spent inside ViolationRestoreBudget (spike S1: a real forced activation arrived as a WM_ACTIVATE that GetForegroundWindow did not confirm yet).

TryNowSendDelay.description: Delay between activating the target app and sending the action.

TryNowReturnDelay.description: Delay after which the control center comes back with the question.

TryNowHoldDuration.description: Hold shortcuts are held, and toggles stay latched, this long during a try.

TryNowSwitchSuppression.description: App switches caused by a try are not user switches during this window.

TryAnimation.description: Phase timeline of the Test card animation.

PlaybackKeyInterval.description: Each key of the combination lights up at this interval.

TapReleasedAfter.description: Tap: the released phase starts this long after the keys.

HoldHoldingAfter.description: Hold: the holding phase starts this long after the keys.

HoldLiftAfter.description: Hold: the lift phase starts this long after holding.

HoldDoneAfter.description: Hold: the done phase starts this long after lifting.

ToggleLatchedAfter.description: Toggle: the latched phase starts this long after the keys.

ToggleSecondTapAfter.description: Toggle: the second tap phase starts this long after latching.

ToggleReleasedAfter.description: Toggle: the released phase starts this long after the second tap.

MacroStepInterval.description: Macro: each step is shown at this interval.

MacroDoneAfter.description: Macro: the done phase starts this long after the last step.

OtherDoneAfter.description: Text, Web, App and Mouse: the done phase starts this long after the sentence.

DocumentSaveDebounce.description: Debounce of document saves after a meaningful change.

DocumentSaveMaxLatency.description: A pending document change is written no later than this.

UsageSaveMaxLatency.description: Pending usage is written no later than this.

WriteRetryBackoff.description: Retries after a transient sharing or lock violation.

WriteRetryInterval.description: After a persistent write failure the save is retried at this interval.

UndoDepth.description: Entries kept in the undo history.

AutoBackupDelay.description: An automatic backup is taken this long after the last meaningful change.

OperationBackupRetention.description: Backups kept per kind before update, migration, restore, import or reset.

MigrationCardVisibility.description: The migration card stays visible at most this long.

PreviousVersionRetention.description: The previous version is kept, and rollback offered, this long after an update.

UsageWindow.description: Only executions within this window count; older marks are purged.

MaxShown.description: Frequents shows at most this many shortcuts.

UpdateCheckInterval.description: Automatic update checks run this often.

UpdateIdleRequired.description: An update installs only after this long without touches.

KeyboardRecordingTimeout.description: The temporary keyboard hook removes itself after this long.

AiRequestTimeout.description: A generation without answer after this long fails as offline.

AiFreeDailyQuota.description: Free generations per local day (only with the deferred quota proxy, proposal P3).

AiNameMaxLength.description: Longest shortcut name accepted from an AI proposal.

TextPreviewLength.description: Characters of a text action shown in tiles and notices.

IconSuggestionsMax.description: Most icons suggested for a name.

IconWordMinLength.description: Name words shorter than this are ignored.

IconReverseMatchMinLength.description: A word may start with an icon tag only when the tag is at least this long.

IpcRequestTimeout.description: Longest time a pipe request may take.

IpcRateLimit.description: Most pipe requests accepted per window.

OpenUriMaxBytes.description: Largest clicalo: URI accepted over the pipe.

ShareMaxDepth.description: Deepest JSON nesting accepted in a shared profile.

ZipMaxTotalBytes.description: Largest total uncompressed size of an imported zip.

ZipMaxEntries.description: Most entries in an imported zip.

ZipMaxCompressionRatio.description: Largest compression ratio per zip entry, counted while reading.

ZipMaxJsonBytes.description: Largest JSON entry inside an imported zip.

LogFileCount.description: Log files kept, including the current one.

DebugLoggingDuration.description: Debug logging requested by the user turns itself off after this long.

DiagnosticTransitionCount.description: Engine transitions (types and codes only) included in a diagnostic package.
